reviewScope: Only the four v1-to-v2 changed sources and the relevant shared raw-read/Keychain/protocol/fixture control flow. The unchanged original JVM and Host implementation are not re-reviewed or re-executed.

closedFindings.sourceConclusion: getLoginInfo no longer conflates an absent Keychain item with an existing non-JSON, empty or unreadable value. It uses readRawLoginInfo before Map parsing, so those present values cannot reach legacy migration.
closedFindings.remainingRuntimeAcceptance: The new and extended Swift tests have not executed against the SDK or actual Keychain.

actualChecks: Read CLAUDE.md and yuedu-swift SKILL.md; no root AGENTS.md was present. Read the prior P1 review and the four exact v1-to-v2 diffs.

readCore returns nil only for errSecItemNotFound; non-success lookup, malformed result, invalid UTF-8, oversized value and failed accessibility migration throw. checkedReadCore preserves those errors.

The shared raw reader reaches UserDefaults only after a checked missing result. Present non-JSON and empty Strings return before legacy access; the Map getter parses only after that proof and returns nil for a non-Map value without mutation.

Legacy migration uses SecItemAdd through insertCore. Only errSecDuplicateItem becomes false. It never falls back to SecItemUpdate/upsert; a competing insert is reread with the same checked read. The legacy value is removed only after accepted insertion and an unchanged legacy snapshot.

The old optional Map signature catches and logs only the error type, then returns nil. It never attempts migration following a locked/unreadable/malformed owner. The raw runtime path retains its worker precondition and caller validator/effect callbacks.

The new Keychain entry points share the existing readCore/insertCore and service/account/accessibility. No second credential owner, queue, synchronous wait, generic cache credential copy, or new UI path was introduced.

Successful migration returns its accepted logical value without an additional read; no new revision-queue work is added to the old synchronous form getter. Runtime put/remove retain their existing revision updates.

The extended existing App method scripts a competing raw winner and an empty winner while stale legacy data remains, checks Map reads do not overwrite either, exercises a checked-read failure, and tests a Map-initiated insert race returning the newer JSON winner.

OwnedCredentials uses an existing locked dictionary with explicit checked read failure and insert-only behavior. CookieFixtureCredentials now opts into checked size/read, save/delete and insert-only behavior using its same existing dictionary/lock. The repository search found no additional concrete LoginCredentialStorage conformer requiring this checked compatibility update.

Verified all 11 frozen candidate source hashes, reconstructed the four changed diffs byte exactly, and verified unchanged Kotlin/manifest hashes against v1. No canonical source, Git state or cloud job was changed.

testBoundary.reason: Only Swift source and existing Swift fixture assertions changed. Unchanged Kotlin evidence remains the earlier stage evidence; source review is not SDK or secure-persistence acceptance.

limitsAndRemainingWork: SDK compilation, actual Keychain behavior and actual JNI execution remain unproven for this candidate. The scripted dictionary winner tests define a race regression; they do not establish a native Keychain race result.
The existing synchronous form Keychain read/migration boundary is retained; this correction does not claim complete main-thread I/O modernization.
The optional legacy Map API logs a sanitized storage failure and returns nil because its signature cannot throw. The runtime raw API can still surface typed STATE_IO; no success is manufactured.
